description: NIST Special Publication 800-53 Revision 5 Security and Privacy Controls for Federal Information Systems

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Manage information system accounts, disable guest accounts, and audit account life cycle.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users and processes.

controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.description: Enforce a limit of consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration, and connection requirements for remote access.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.description: Identify that the system can audit organization-defined events including process creation and logons.

controls.title: Audit Record Generation
controls.description: Provide audit record generation capability for the auditable events with command line detail.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.description: Configure systems to provide only essential capabilities and prohibit unneeded protocols like SMBv1.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Protect authenticators and passwords in memory and in transit.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at external boundary and key internal boundaries via firewall.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest using cryptographic volume encryption.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: Employ malicious code protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points.
